# Professional & Research Experience

## Financial Risk and Policy Response (Bank of China Research Project)
- Conducted in-depth analysis of U.S. tariff impacts on Canada, focusing on sectoral exposure across automotive, energy, and manufacturing industries.
- Evaluated fiscal risks using historical debt data (2015–2024) and projected interest cost trends.
- Developed strategic recommendations for Chinese financial institutions, including trade finance expansion and cross-border RMB services.

## Economic Impact of U.S. Tariffs on Canada
- Built statistical models to estimate GDP contraction, employment changes, and inflation risks under a 25% tariff scenario.
- Analyzed trade flows and supply chain disruptions using historical data (2019–2023).
- Delivered policy insights to support risk mitigation and diversification strategies.

## Community-Centered Strategy Project (University of Toronto)
- Led a team to redesign program structures and improve participation rates through data-driven insights.
- Developed strategic business plans and budget frameworks for community outreach initiatives.

## Sustainable Development Financial Planning Project
- Designed a $2.39 million budget plan to improve food supply chains in rural China.
- Proposed financial incentives and partnership strategies involving governments and financial institutions.
